judged_text: `feed_key` ("feed-modified:..." Redis key) is defined but never referenced anywhere in the diff — the conditional-get/modified check it was built for was never wired in. Dead code that misleads maintainers into thinking modified-only polling exists; every hour the job fetches and re-parses the full feed and runs a SELECT + import decision per item regardless of whether anything changed, and the next person changing polling logic has to discover the key is phantom.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, `def feed_key` constructs a Redis key (`"feed-modified:..."`) but that method is never called anywhere in the diff (not in `execute`, not in `poll_feed`, and not elsewhere). The job always does `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` on every run and iterates `rss.items` without any conditional-get/If-Modified-Since or Redis-stored modified/etag check. This is dead/unused code that implies an optimization/feature (modified-only polling) that is not actually implemented.
